```{r}
filtered_data <- reactive({
  data <- capture %>%
    mutate(
      sex_clean = tolower(trimws(as.character(sex))),
      age_clean = tolower(trimws(as.character(age))),
      repro_clean = trimws(as.character(repro_status))
    )

  if (isTRUE(input$adult_only)) {
    data <- data %>%
      filter(
        sex_clean %in% c("f", "female"),
        age_clean %in% c("adult", "ad")
      )
  }

  if (input$site_filter != "All") {
    data <- data %>% filter(site == input$site_filter)
  }

  data
})
```



```{r shiny-app, eval=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)

capture <- read.csv("Data/capture_cleaned.csv")

capture$date <- as.Date(capture$date)
capture$month <- as.numeric(format(capture$date, "%m"))

capture$sex <- as.factor(capture$sex)
capture$age <- as.factor(capture$age)
capture$site <- as.factor(capture$site)
capture$repro_status <- as.factor(capture$repro_status)

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(title = "Bat Reproductive Timing"),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      id = "tabs",
      menuItem("Reproductive Timing", tabName = "repro")
    )
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    tabItems(
      tabItem(
        tabName = "repro",
        fluidRow(
          box(
            width = 4,
            selectInput(
              "site_filter",
              "Select Site",
              choices = c("All", levels(capture$site)),
              selected = "All"
            ),
            checkboxInput(
              "adult_only",
              "Only Adult Females (if available)",
              value = TRUE
            )
          ),
          
          box(
            width = 8,
            status = "primary",
            solidHeader = TRUE,
            textOutput("filter_msg"),
            plotOutput("repro_month_plot", height = 350),
            verbatimTextOutput("repro_summary")
          )
        ),
        
        fluidRow(
          box(
            width = 12,
            status = "primary",
            solidHeader = TRUE,
            plotOutput("repro_site_plot", height = 400)
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- capture
    
    if (input$site_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(site == input$site_filter)
    }
    
    # Try applying the "adult females" filter
    if (isTRUE(input$adult_only)) {
      df_try <- df %>% filter(sex == "F", age == "Adult")
      
      # If it produces 0 rows, fall back to unfiltered df
      if (nrow(df_try) == 0) {
        return(df)   # fallback
      } else {
        return(df_try)
      }
    }
    
    df
  })
  
  output$filter_msg <- renderText({
    df_base <- capture
    if (input$site_filter != "All") df_base <- df_base %>% filter(site == input$site_filter)
    
    if (isTRUE(input$adult_only)) {
      n_try <- nrow(df_base %>% filter(sex == "F", age == "Adult"))
      if (n_try == 0) {
        return("Note: No Adult Females exist for this selection, so the app is showing all bats instead.")
      }
    }
    ""
  })
  
  output$repro_month_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- filtered_data() %>%
      mutate(repro_clean = trimws(as.character(repro_status)))
    
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data to plot."))
    
    summary_df <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(repro_clean), repro_clean != "") %>%
      group_by(month, repro_clean) %>%
      summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
    
    ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = month, y = count, fill = repro_clean)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
      labs(
        title = "Reproductive Status by Month",
        x = "Month",
        y = "Number of Bats",
        fill = "Reproductive Status"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
  })
  
  output$repro_site_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- filtered_data() %>%
      mutate(repro_clean = trimws(as.character(repro_status)))
    
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data to plot."))
    
    summary_df <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(repro_clean), repro_clean != "") %>%
      group_by(site, repro_clean) %>%
      summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
    
    ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = site, y = count, fill = repro_clean)) +
      geom_col() +
      labs(
        title = "Reproductive Status by Site",
        x = "Site",
        y = "Number of Bats",
        fill = "Status"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })
  
  output$repro_summary <- renderPrint({
    df <- filtered_data() %>%
      mutate(repro_clean = trimws(as.character(repro_status)))
    
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data to summarize."))
    
    summary_df <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(repro_clean), repro_clean != "") %>%
      mutate(reproductive = repro_clean %in% c("Pregnant", "Lactating", "Post-lactating")) %>%
      summarise(
        total_bats = n(),
        reproductive_bats = sum(reproductive),
        proportion_reproductive = reproductive_bats / total_bats
      )
    
    print(summary_df)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
